Mina (Finance): AP hold on invoice 2026-CL-489 — bot says PO mismatch and unit price differs from SOW. Can AP confirm required docs? :thinking:

Sam (AP): AP bot: HOLD_REASON=PO_MISMATCH; missing PO reference and unit price $0.09 vs PO shows $0.075. Need either matching PO or signed amendment.

Irene (Vendor Ops): Reached out to CloudLine. They claim new pricing tier v2 started Feb and they emailed a sales rep but no signed amendment. They offered to reissue at old rate if needed.

Raj (Procurement): We don't accept unilateral retroactive price increases without a signed change order. If vendor can reissue under existing PO (4120) we're fine. Otherwise require amendment with explicit effective date + signatures.

Sam (AP): For routing, amendment needs: "Effective 2026-02-01, GPU rate = $0.09/hr" and vendor + Redwood signature. Then AP will create new PO or update PO references.

Mina (Finance): Ask vendor to reissue invoice under PO 4120 at $0.075 or provide signed amendment. Don't accept emailed confirmation alone — audit will flag it.

Irene (Vendor Ops): CloudLine responded: they'll reissue at old rate for this invoice and submit a formal amendment for future billing. Sending new PDF now. :email:

billing-bot: Invoice 2026-CL-489v2 uploaded by Irene — status CHANGED to PENDING_MATCH (PO 4120).

Sam (AP): Verified match and early-pay terms, routing for payment. Closing hold. :white_check_mark:

Mina (Finance): Thanks. Raj, please flag in vendor master: require signed amendment for any tier/pricing changes going forward.

Raj (Procurement): Noted and updated vendor record.
